# stripe Provider

Manage Stripe and Metronome resources with Terraform. Both API clients use the
top-level `api_key` or `STRIPE_API_KEY`. Metronome receives that key as a Bearer
token. Standalone Metronome API tokens are not used.

Use Terraform 1.16.5 or later for Metronome resources, cross-provider migration,
and actions. Stripe resources retain their existing configuration.

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.16.5"
  required_providers {
    stripe = { source = "stripe/stripe" }
  }
}

provider "stripe" {}

resource "stripe_metronome_account_bridge" "billing" {}

module "billing" {
  source     = "./billing"
  depends_on = [stripe_metronome_account_bridge.billing]
}
```

Set `STRIPE_API_KEY` in the process environment. The account bridge activates
Metronome access and waits for readiness before the module's operations run.
Activation requires the appropriate account permissions and business profile.

See [Metronome setup and migration](guides/metronome.md) for existing-state
bootstrap, provider aliases, migration, and the account bridge's lifecycle.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Stripe API key. Can also be set via the STRIPE_API_KEY environment variable.
- `metronome` (Attributes) Optional Metronome transport settings. Uses the same Stripe API key as Stripe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metronome))
- `stripe_account` (String) Connected account context for Connect-scoped requests. Can also be set via the STRIPE_ACCOUNT environment variable.

<a id="nestedatt--metronome"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metronome`

Optional:

- `base_url` (String) HTTPS API origin; defaults to METRONOME_BASE_URL, then https://api.metronome.com.
- `ca_cert_file` (String) PEM CA file; defaults to METRONOME_CA_CERT_FILE.
